specification.title: Stale evidence is surfaced by an explicit limitation
specification.description: Material threat evidence intentionally designated stale by the scenario must be accompanied by an explicit staleness limitation rather than a hidden freshness policy.
specification.purpose: Verify material threat evidence designated stale is still considered, with the staleness explicitly stated as a limitation instead of silently dropped by a hidden freshness policy.
specification.operational_relevance: Threat intelligence decays; a hidden recency discount makes final assessments look stronger than the underlying data supports.
specification.regression_risk: The analyst could silently discount the stale reputation evidence or forget to declare the staleness limitation, unresolved question, and next step.

required: The Assessment includes the Supporting reputation Finding backed by the stale evidence
The Assessment states the staleness limitation, unresolved question, and recommended next step
forbidden: The Assessment applies a hidden freshness discount without declaring the staleness limitation

fixture.objective: Assess the target IP from reputation evidence that is materially stale.

required_limitations: The reputation observation is materially stale and needs revalidation.
required_unresolved_questions: Whether the indicator is still active at analysis time.
required_next_steps: Revalidate the indicator against a current reputation source.
